summary: Kerb at the bend's south end, apartments about 20 m behind; busy street.
reasons: Cars do park at this kerb
Dense housing and apartments all round

best_section.where: Station Road west kerb, southern end of the bend, beside the parked car

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks 20-27 m away on the same side and more across the road; homes all round within 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a two-lane road; a parked car sits at the kerb here, so room exists but it is tight.
drivers.traffic: Through street linking Indooroopilly centre; steady traffic and noise.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb at this end; earlier stretch has No Stopping signs and half-hour parking.

flags: Dwelling 8 m from the kerb at 28 m, so avoid the first half
Slope about 5% between 50 and 65 m (mean 2.6% overall)
No Stopping Mon-Sat 7am-7pm signs on the northern part
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the west side; morning shade from the buildings behind, afternoon sun from the west.
